description: Český úřad zeměměřický a katastrální: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Český úřad zeměměřický a katastrální. Coverage: Český úřad zeměměřický a katastrální. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: téma Dopravní sítě - vodní doprava (TN_WATER); Katalog objektů ZABAGED - Komunikace; téma Dopravní sítě - železniční doprava (TN_RAIL); téma Dopravní sítě - silniční doprava (TN_ROAD). Formats seen: ATOM, JSON_LD. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00025712/efa9396b2cbf78d05baad5167c76e326/distribuce/89c222ab41a6b12e3482dbf35b17e2ad/podmínky-užití), as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00025712/f46ada3491a6bb5a14e0249998783b8d/distribuce/19bb8198e636e2b0c0a17df7b882e1fd/podmínky-užití), as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00025712/e8fe63da672cd776c9cf3bf2ba25e727/distribuce/c0e1d244b92647c9ba3c897f5f36ee4b/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
